bc6d039068: Spends rely on zk-STARKs (hash functions only), note encryption uses ML-KEM-1024 (FIPS 203) combined with X25519, peers use ML-KEM-768. Shor's algorithm breaks none of these; Grover's algorithm only halves hash security, and 256-bit hashes keep a 128-bit margin. All algorithms are versioned so they can be upgraded by soft fork. The code has not had an independent audit yet.
